test_DummyFormat_execute: test the DummyFormat.execute method to parse an INI-style config file and return a lit.Test.Result
create_DummyFormat_class: create a DummyFormat subclass of lit.formats.FileBasedTest to parse .ini test result files
build_lit_test_result: build a lit.Test.Result object from parsed INI config with result code and output string
add_test_metrics: add integer and float metrics to a lit.Test.Result using IntMetricValue and RealMetricValue
add_micro_results: add nested micro test results to a parent lit.Test.Result via addMicroResult
